'''Lord Solusar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was part of the Imperial forces present during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
